versions.changelog:
Initial release of jadwal-sholat.

- Fetch jadwal sholat (imsak, subuh, dzuhur, ashar, maghrib, isya) for Indonesian cities/regencies from api.myquran.com.
- Supports queries for today, a specific date, or a whole month.
- Allows searching for city/regency IDs.
- Provides helper script and curl instructions for easy access.
- Uses official data from Kemenag Bimas Islam.
